$$
\begin{aligned}F(x,y)&=-y\,\mathbf{i}+x\,\mathbf{j} \\ G(x,y)&=-y\,\mathbf{i}-y\,\mathbf{j}\end{aligned}
$$

- The vertical component (the $j$ component) varies with the vertical coordinate $y$. Its magnitude grows as we move away from $y=0$, where it is zero. It is negative when $y>0$ and positive when $y<0$. Therefore, we can rule out:

$$
K(x,y)=x\,\mathbf{i}+x\,\mathbf{j}
$$

Therefore, we conclude that the diagram corresponds to the vector field $H(x,y)=x\,\mathbf{i}-y\,\mathbf{j}.$
